Complete unary system: the count needs degree B = k(2h+2) about n^1.5, non-refutation allows B <= n/2 (leg scan n = 3..200); density loss k^2/2n beats flat gain hk^2/n^2.

formal_statement: ∀ p : Polynomial ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.LinClause (Fin (n + 1) × Fin n)), PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsLinRefutation (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.PHP (n + 1) n) π → p.eval n < π.length
plain_statement: OPEN, truth unknown, no known method. No polynomial bounds the length of dag-like Res(+) refutations of PHP (n+1) n. Replaces L-pcx-015, which the red team showed trivially true at n = 1. Tree-like bounds: Itsykson and Sokolov, MFCS 2014.
title: TARGET (open problem): Res(+) refutations of the pigeonhole formula are not polynomially bounded
